metadata.description: Open provenance map describing how this candidate output was produced. Additional keys remain allowed; the properties named here are reserved so that the same fact is spelled the same way across harnesses, which is what makes cross-run comparison well-defined. All are optional.

profile.description: Serving profile that produced the output, as named by the endpoint that served it (e.g. "worker-fast"). A profile names a resolved configuration -- model, context policy, sampling defaults -- not merely a model.

engine.description: Inference engine and version that executed the profile (e.g. "llama.cpp@b2497f88", "vllm-0.14.1"). Two profiles may name the same weights yet differ here, and that difference is frequently the explanation for a scoring delta.

artifact_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the weight artifact actually loaded. Quantisations of one model share a name and do not share behaviour; this is the field that distinguishes them.
